description: Static structural contract for the R1 fallback control. R1 is documented as a fallback only — the primary integration is R2 (T-L4-CR-001). R1 ships as a workflow-override TOML (bmad-code-review.toml) with on_complete = 'rdx-judgment'. Per RDX_TEST_STRATEGY.md §8, R1 has a timing limitation: rdx-judgment runs AFTER triage and story status update, so its findings cannot influence the standard review's verdict. The structural contract here proves the fallback artefact exists, declares the on_complete hook, and carries the timing-limitation disclaimer so future maintainers don't promote R1 to primary by accident.
